caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wood-framed embroidery sampler. The frame is dark brown, with diagonal lines simulating wood grain and mitered corners, and the inner edge is lined with a thin gold border. The sampler itself has a light grayish background. The embroidery within the frame features text in red thread at the center, surrounded by flowers, leaves, and two animals at the bottom. The flowers are in shades of purple, pink, red, and white, with green leaves and stems arching around and above the text. The animal on the left appears to be a white and pink rabbit, while the animal on the right is red and brown. At the top center is a small bird composed of brown, blue, and red threads. The text in the sampler is written in several lines and reads: "Presented By The Relief Society To Sister Eliz. Grindlay 1876." The entire composition is centered on a cream-colored background, with a faint rectangular outline indicating the border of the paper. In the lower right corner, there is small handwritten text: "Lilly McCarrel." In the lower left, there is another handwritten note: "1/3 Size."
title: Sampler
